title: Detailed camera
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- camera body -->
  <rect x='10' y='30' width='80' height='50' rx='8' fill='#3a4a68'/>
  <!-- top highlight on body -->
  <rect x='14' y='34' width='72' height='6' rx='3' fill='#50628a'/>
  <!-- grip texture -->
  <rect x='12' y='40' width='10' height='36' rx='4' fill='#2e3d58'/>
  <rect x='14' y='44' width='6' height='28' rx='3' fill='#4a5c82'/>
  <!-- viewfinder hump -->
  <rect x='35' y='22' width='24' height='12' rx='4' fill='#3a4a68'/>
  <rect x='37' y='24' width='20' height='6' rx='3' fill='#50628a'/>
  <!-- flash -->
  <rect x='62' y='24' width='16' height='8' rx='3' fill='#c8d6f0'/>
  <rect x='64' y='26' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#f0f6ff'/>
  <!-- mode dial -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='36' r='5' fill='#8a9cc0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='36' r='2' fill='#c8d6f0'/>
  <!-- shutter button -->
  <rect x='20' y='24' width='10' height='7' rx='3' fill='#e05a5a'/>
  <rect x='22' y='25' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ff8a8a'/>
  <!-- lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='24' fill='#2e3d58'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='21' fill='#4a5c82'/>
  <!-- lens glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='16' fill='#1a2a48'/>
  <!-- lens reflections -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='13' fill='#24406a'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='50' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#6a8cc8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='62' r='3' fill='#8aaee0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- lens inner ring detail -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#3a5a8a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- aperture blades suggestion -->
  <polygon points='50,46 55,49 57,55 54,60 48,60 45,55 47,49' fill='#2e4a78' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='4' fill='#0e1e38'/>
  <!-- lens highlight -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='50' r='2' fill='#aac4f0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- brand text bar -->
  <rect x='28' y='70' width='24' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8a9cc0'/>
  <!-- bottom detail line -->
  <rect x='14' y='76' width='72' height='2' rx='1' fill='#2e3d58'/>
  <!-- strap lugs -->
  <rect x='4' y='42' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#8a9cc0'/>
  <rect x='88' y='42' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#8a9cc0'/>
</svg>
